brief.goal: Get a category suggestion for an expense described as "Uber ride to the airport".

mustCover.must: Suggests a category that is in the household's own category list, not an invented one
Gives a brief reason for the suggestion

mustNot.mustNot: Creates, renames or deletes a category
Claims the category was set when it was only suggested

brief.goal: Get a category suggestion for a vague expense described only as "stuff".

mustCover.must: Says plainly that the description is too vague to match confidently, while still offering its closest guess from the list

mustNot.mustNot: Invents a category not in the household's list
States a confident match it has no basis for
